title: All Social Video Downloader
summary: A fast video downloader for social media.
description:
VDFR is an easy to use video downloader for Instagram, Facebook, Stories, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and TikTok.  Download videos and images from your favorite social networks with ease.  

Features:

- Easily download videos, images, and GIFs from Instagram, Facebook, Stories, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and TikTok.
- Download videos or images from Instagram posts containing multiple media.
- Share the videos and images to any app directly from the VDFR app.
- Access all your downloaded images and videos right inside the app.
- Play downloaded videos and view downloaded images right from the app.

How to use:

Method - 1 (Recommended)

1. Open the post containing the video or image that you want to download.
2. Tap on the Share icon below the post to open the Share menu.
3. Select VDFR from the list of apps to begin downloading the video or image.

Method - 2

1. Copy the link to the post containing the video or image that you want to download.
2. Open the VDFR app, select the app that you want to download the video from, and use the clipboard icon to paste the link.
3. Tap on Download to begin downloading the video or image inside the app.
